title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11203)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_11203) covers Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11203). This Indian Standard, which is identical with ISO 2033-1983 ' Information processing — Coding of machine readable characters ( MICR and OCR )', issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO ), was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on the recommendation of the Computers, Business Machine and Calculators Sectional Committee and approved by the Electronics and Telecommunication Division Council. In this standard, certain terminology and conventions are not identical with those used in Indian Standards; attention is specially drawn to the following : Wherever the words ' International Standard ' appear, referring to this standard, they should be read as ' Indian Standard '. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
